name: Hootsuite MCP
description: Drafts social posts, triages the social inbox, and tracks brand mentions and sentiment in Hootsuite from ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Gemini, for social media teams.

skills.name: Post Drafting (Perch)
skills.description: Creates and updates social post drafts, uploads media and places drafts on the Planner calendar; a person still publishes them in Hootsuite.

skills.name: Social Analytics (Perch)
skills.description: Queries social performance metrics such as impressions, engagement and follower growth across connected profiles through the Perch analytics tools.

skills.name: Inbox Triage (Nest)
skills.description: Lists inbox conversations, posts and comments, then assigns owners, adds internal notes, tags topics and changes status; it cannot send replies.

skills.name: Social Listening (Lumen)
skills.description: Searches brand and keyword mentions, tracks sentiment, volume and trends, and finds top influencers for topics in your Lumen projects.

skills.name: Employee Advocacy (Parliament)
skills.description: Creates and manages advocacy posts and drafts, and shares approved content from the curated library to an advocate's own social profiles.
